description: This line plot illustrates the Similarity across different Layers for four language pairs: en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. All four lines are solid and lack markers. The dark red line representing "en&en" begins at layer 0 with a similarity of approximately 0.07, rises to a prominent peak of roughly 0.26 at layer 6, and then drops to about 0.16 at layer 7. It forms a smaller, broader peak around layer 12 at 0.18, declines to a minimum of approximately 0.08 at layer 20, and finishes with a sharp spike to its maximum value of about 0.43 at layer 23. The light blue line for "en&es" starts at layer 0 at roughly 0.06, reaches a peak of about 0.24 at layer 6, and falls to 0.15 at layer 7. Following a slight rise to 0.17 at layer 12, it decreases to a low of roughly 0.05 at layer 20, before sharply rising to end at approximately 0.27 at layer 23. The light green line representing "en&el" begins at layer 0 with a value near 0.04, peaks at approximately 0.15 at layer 6, and dips to 0.10 at layer 7. It rises again to about 0.15 at layer 12, steadily declines to a low of roughly 0.04 between layers 18 and 20, and concludes with a sharp increase to about 0.30 at layer 23. Finally, the light purple line for "en&bn" starts at layer 0 at approximately 0.03, reaches a peak of about 0.14 at layer 6, and drops to 0.09 at layer 7. It forms a secondary peak of roughly 0.14 at layer 12, decreases to a minimum near 0.04 between layers 18 and 20, and ends with a steep climb to approximately 0.29 at layer 23.
